scope.purpose: Define the minimum public-safe evidence required to assign accountable personnel and provision isolated Proton/AWS resources for a synthetic EGC dry run.

resource_controls.name: isolated_aws_account_and_region
required_properties: dedicated test account or organizational isolation

resource_controls.name: private_administration_and_mapping_store
required_properties: identity mapping excluded from public evidence

completion_rules: An assignment may be accepted only when accepted=true and pseudonym, accepted_at_utc, and evidence_path are non-null.
A resource control may be provisioned only when provisioned=true, public_alias is non-null, and at least one evidence path demonstrates every required property.

Public evidence must use non-secret aliases and must not contain credentials, direct account identifiers, real contact data, protected mappings, constructor targets, anchor identities, rationales, or private holdout material.
Every P01-P12 gate must receive an evidence-backed independent-review disposition before execution can be considered.

execution_allowed must remain false while any assignment, ownership role, resource control, leakage scan, evidence-closure check, or independent-review disposition is incomplete, failed, or unresolved.
A failed or stopped run must be preserved as such and may not be edited into a pass.
claim_limits: This record assigns no person and authenticates no identity.
This record demonstrates no Proton or AWS resource.
This record validates no scientific construct, EGC hypothesis, hidden intention, awareness, deception, subjectivity, or consciousness claim.
blockers: No primary operator has accepted responsibility.
No independent audit reviewer has accepted responsibility.
No Proton or AWS resource evidence exists.
No frozen synthetic artifact set exists.
